integrity: The finite claims are completely and independently enumerated by two standalone Python programs using distinct minimal-dominating-set predicates; a complete depth-five adaptive tree and all 462 five-query supports are checked. Infinite product assertions have a separate mathematical argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite cycle analysis is restricted to sizes 3 through 11, with infinite families only from disjoint unions of eleven-cycles. No exact dimension formula is asserted for longer connected cycles. Historical priority under alternative domination-hypergraph or thicket terminology is not guaranteed; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: The first minimal-domination cycle gap: complete five-query traces and a vertex-transitive amplification
